rules.description: SYN connection attempt to the editing service.
LOCK marker bytes are present; reassemble and distinguish LOCK from UNLOCK.

rules.filter: tcp.port==5016 && (frame contains "BUSY" || frame contains "ERR_LOCKED" || frame contains "LOCK_DENIED")
rules.description: A BUSY/ERR_LOCKED/LOCK_DENIED marker is present; assert the competing request and unchanged owner.
SAVE marker bytes are present; verify the saved document and version.

rules.filter: tcp.port==5016 && (frame contains "DOC_UPDATE" || frame contains "UPDATED" || frame contains "VERSION")
rules.description: An update/version marker is present; verify the recipient and actual post-save state.

manual_checks: R1 R2 R3: Assert B receives the declared refusal and that A remains owner.
R4 R5: Compare saved content/version and notification recipient; a version marker alone is insufficient.
